hook: Open-weight: an AI model whose trained weights are released, under a license.
definition: An AI model whose trained weights are published, so developers can run it themselves instead of through the maker's cloud.
example: Meta released the weights of Muse Spark Open, 816 billion parameters. Meta says it runs on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios.
the_catch: Open-weight comes with terms. Meta's weights use the Muse Model License, which has 'limited commercial terms'.
caption: Open-weight means a model's trained weights are published, so developers can run it themselves. Meta did that with Muse Spark Open, but under a license with limited commercial terms. Would you rather run an AI model on your own desk or in the cloud?
alt_text: A five-slide glossary carousel defining open-weight: an AI model whose trained weights are published so developers can run it themselves, an example from an earlier gummietech post on Meta's Muse Spark Open, and the common mistake that open-weight means no conditions.

es.hook: Open-weight: un modelo de IA cuyos pesos entrenados se liberan bajo una licencia.
es.definition: Un modelo de IA cuyos pesos entrenados se publican, de modo que los desarrolladores pueden ejecutarlo por sí mismos en lugar de hacerlo a través de la nube del creador.
es.example: Meta liberó los pesos de Muse Spark Open, con 816 mil millones de parámetros. Meta afirma que funciona en dos Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios.
es.the_catch: Open-weight viene con términos. Los pesos de Meta usan la Muse Model License, que incluye «términos comerciales limitados».
